boardName: Craft and painting YouTube channels for kids

items.title: The Best Ideas for Kids
items.description: All ages · free. The shortest supply lists here — most of it starts with what is already in a kitchen drawer. Easy to pick by season. Run by Kimberly McLeod.
items.descriptionKo: 전 연령 · 무료. 준비물이 제일 적어요. 집에 이미 있는 걸로 바로 시작해요. 계절마다 골라 쓰기 좋아요. Kimberly McLeod가 운영해요.

items.title: Red Ted Art
items.description: Preschool–primary · free. Maggy Woodley makes it — bright, inventive, heavy on paper folding and turning packaging into something else. Short enough instructions for a child to follow alone.
items.descriptionKo: 유아~초등 · 무료. Maggy Woodley가 만들어요. 종이접기, 재활용품 만들기가 많아요. 설명이 짧고 명확해서 아이 혼자 따라 하기도 괜찮아요.

items.title: Messy Little Monster
items.description: Preschool · free. Louise, a mother of three and an early years teacher, makes it. This is the messy-play one — squishing, smearing, hands in it. The printables are free.
items.descriptionKo: 유아 · 무료. 세 아이 엄마이자 유아교사인 Louise가 만들어요. 어지르는 놀이를 다뤄요. 손으로 만지고 문지르는 활동이 많고, 도안도 무료예요.

items.title: Babble Dabble Do
items.description: Primary · free. Ana Dziengel trained in architecture and industrial design, and it shows — a lot of what you make here stands up and holds together. For an older child who wants to know why it works.
items.descriptionKo: 초등 · 무료. 건축과 산업디자인을 공부한 Ana Dziengel이 만들어요. 만들면 구조가 되는 것들이 많아요. “왜 이렇게 되지?”를 배우기 좋아요.

items.title: Deep Space Sparkle
items.description: Primary · free. This is the painting one. Patty Palmer teaches it the way an art teacher would, in proper lessons. For the child who would rather paint than build.
items.descriptionKo: 초등 · 무료. 여기가 그림물감 자리예요. 미술 교사 Patty Palmer가 수업하듯 알려줘요. 만들기보다 그리기·칠하기에 관심 있는 아이에게 맞아요.
